facts.fact: Hsu 和 Garcia 快到了——Alex 继续在谷仓口盘问验尸官。
facts.anchor: Hsu and Garcia were getting close.

facts.fact: Alex 决定留到最后：要别人认真干，自己就得最后一个走、立下规矩。
facts.anchor: then she had to be the last one to leave

facts.fact: 电话不是后援，是陌生号码——Lacey 打来的，背景一片争吵。
facts.anchor: It was a number she didn’t recognize.

facts.fact: April 拒绝进警局；Scott Cook 要求知道妻子下落；他们全聚在 Gallagher 家。
facts.anchor: It’s April Gallagher. She won’t come into the station.

facts.fact: Lacey 说「他们不听我的」——Alex 怒斥：你可是警长。
Alex 开车犯困——她关掉暖气、摇下冷窗自罚清醒。
facts.anchor: She swore, turning off the heaters and rolling down the window instead

facts.fact: Dunning 路牌闪过：人口 5,241——累到一眨眼就会错过的镇子。
facts.anchor: The green Dunning sign flashed past: population 5,241.

facts.fact: Scott 抢过电话：「我不在乎你是谁——我妻子在哪」。

facts.fact: Alex 下巴旧伤发痛：摔断过、钛板钉进骨头。
facts.anchor: where a titanium plate had been screwed into the bone.

facts.fact: Scott 问 Rebecca 是不是死了——Alex 的沉默说了一切。
facts.anchor: But she knew her silence said everything.
